subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram forum topic title-to-topic_id routing, and should that contract be an observed-topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver, or explicit numeric-only routing?
rationale: Current main has a learned id-to-name cache but no authoritative Telegram lookup; selecting forward routing defines stale, duplicate-title, and rename behavior across message actions, prompt context, and plugin metadata.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned catalog/list surface returning known topic IDs, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can ask or choose when results are ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct title-to-topic_id helper that fails with structured stale or ambiguous errors instead of silently routing on weak matches.

options.title: Keep Numeric-Only Routing
options.body: Document topic names as display/context metadata only and require numeric topic IDs or chatId:topic:threadId for routing.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned catalog/list surface returning known topic IDs, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can ask or choose when results are ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work covers both the topic-name data flow and Telegram action normalization surfaces that would define the contract.
